task.question: In the group stage match between Ghana and Panama on June 17, 2026, in which minute did Ghana score their latest ever goal in regulation time at a World Cup?
task.evidence: The 95th minute strike was also Ghana's latest ever goal scored in regulation time at a World Cup.

answer:
Perfect! I found the answer. According to the Wikipedia article about Group L of the 2026 FIFA World Cup, in the match between Ghana and Panama on June 17, 2026:

Caleb Yirenkyi scored Ghana's goal in the **95th minute**, which was also Ghana's latest ever goal scored in regulation time at a World Cup.

FINAL: 95
